properties.name: Niño 1+2
properties.note: Coastal South America; responds first to eastern-Pacific (‘coastal’) El Niño.

properties.name: Niño 3
properties.note: Eastern equatorial Pacific; historically the main ENSO monitoring region.

properties.name: Niño 3.4
properties.note: Used for the Oceanic Niño Index (ONI), NOAA’s official ENSO indicator.

properties.name: Niño 4
properties.note: Central-western Pacific; tracks ‘Modoki’ / central-Pacific El Niño events.

properties.name: IOD West Pole (WTIO)
properties.note: Western tropical Indian Ocean; the Dipole Mode Index is West minus East SST anomaly.

properties.name: IOD East Pole (SETIO)
properties.note: South-eastern tropical Indian Ocean off Sumatra/Java.
